_note: A land or building sale is computed on the cost of acquisition alone, while 2025 s.72(1)(b) with s.90(1)(b) / 1961 s.48 with s.55(1)(b) also deduct the cost of any improvement — which can only lower the tax. Not built (W-088g7): no improvement is recorded. The law reaches any capital asset; the row is scoped to land or building, the kind W-088g7 builds, because a share has no improvement. An ATTENTION notice on the bucket's term line (W-088g4, D-432); building W-088g7 deletes the row. It cites the definitions (s.90(1)(b); s.55(1)(b)(2)) rather than the deducting sections, which are MODELLED for the cost of acquisition and so may not be named by a row that models nothing (CoverageCitationTest). Sources: docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-11-01-land-sale-provisions.md rows 2, 3, 9.
